modules.module_title: Verify and scrutinise respondent's background information and/or documentation

pcs.pc_description: Follow client's prescribed process and prepare for fieldwork by collecting necessary background information from various sources before the visit.
Conduct the field visit by asking relevant questions to appropriate people.
Physically scrutinize and verify all necessary documents (e.g., address, identity, employment proofs).
Handle challenging situations safely and professionally, maintaining the dignity of all parties involved.
Capture comprehensive evidence by operating digital equipment (like smartphone apps or cameras) to collect clear, legible documentary, written, digital, or photographic proof.

Cross-verify document authenticity using authorized electronic protocols (e.g., QR codes, e- verification links) and sourcing additional supportive information from the internet or relevant institutions.

Prepare and submit a complete status report in the required written and/or digital formats, including all collected documents, reports, and evidence, following established submission processes
Escalate issues immediately by raising an alarm or flagging insufficiency if the verification is unsuccessful or if more details are required, as per the established process.
Provide feedback to the client for future process and quality improvements

modules.module_title: Manage work as a freelancer or independent worker

pcs.pc_description: Establish, maintain, and periodically follow up with professional and business contacts within the industry to generate potential work opportunities.
Identify and engage with relevant professional networks, online platforms, and expert organizations that can support freelance or independent work.
Develop and implement appropriate strategies to enhance personal brand, credibility, and visibility among potential clients.
Ensure systems or processes (manual or digital) are in place to identify new work opportunities and client requirements early.
Maintain and circulate an up-to-date professional profile, portfolio, and summary of past work or achievements through digital platforms.
Accurately take dictation or record notes using shorthand, transcription tools, or voice-recording applications as per assignment requirements.
Apply appropriate shorthand symbols, abbreviations, and conventions to ensure speed and clarity of recorded material.
Review and verify shorthand notes or digital recordings for completeness before transcription.
Maintain confidentiality and secure storage of all dictated or transcribed materials.
Transcribe shorthand notes or voice recordings accurately into professional documents, ensuring grammatical and factual correctness.
Use relevant software tools (e.g., word processors, transcription applications) to prepare clean, formatted copies of transcribed content.
Incorporate feedback from clients or supervisors to improve transcription quality and turnaround time.
Ensure final documents are proofread, formatted, and delivered in the agreed format and within the stipulated timeline.
Set SMART (Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, Time-bound) goals for skill and business development based on feedback and performance evaluation.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of work assignments, contracts, and payments using manual or digital systems.
Use digital tools or applications to track income, expenses, and client invoices for financial transparency and compliance.
Establish and maintain access to support services such as IT assistance, accounting, or legal guidance as required.
Plan business development activities aligned with income targets, resource availability, and cash flow needs.
Demonstrate adaptability by managing diverse client requirements, timelines, and deliverables while maintaining professional ethics.
Estimate and agree on realistic fees, timelines, and deliverables with clients in advance.
Clearly define performance expectations, quality standards, and communication protocols with clients before starting an engagement
Ensure that all contracts contain essential clauses such as scope of work, deliverables, payment schedule, ownership of output, and dispute resolution terms.
Verify that the signed contract accurately reflects agreed terms and store it securely in physical or digital format.
Utilize email, cloud platforms, or professional messaging tools to maintain transparent and traceable communication with clients.
Use simple digital invoicing templates or apps to raise, send, and track payments for completed work.
Document work-related expenses digitally using mobile apps or spreadsheets to support budgeting and reimbursement tracking.
